title: Objection: the outer surface is PVC
description:
Women's handbag with an outer surface of genuine cowhide leather, zipper closure, two shoulder straps and a polyester lining. Retail value about $45.

Correction to the facts, which overrides anything above: The outer surface is PVC plastic sheeting, not leather.
